claim: Every run presents six irreversible choices and reaches an ending.
sandbox: fresh demo route; make six fixed choices; assert each prior choice disappears and an end screen appears

claim: The expedition has four reachable endings.
sandbox: fresh demo route for each scripted path; reach and assert all four named endings through the rendered game

claim: Restart clears every choice and returns all resources to 7.
sandbox: make a choice, restart, and assert Camp 1 plus three resource meters at 7

claim: Demo play is not saved and does not change real browser data.
sandbox: seed a real-data sentinel; play, change demo settings, and reset; assert localStorage is unchanged

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: own fresh browser context; load demo and wait for its service worker; set context offline; reload and continue play

where: first screen, Local data and limits, Privacy, README
sandbox: record every request through a full demo run and assert every request is same-origin
change real-play sound and save settings, reload, and assert the changed setting is restored
